answer: The six phases of the UOW AI lifecycle are: 1. Discovery, Data collection and annotation/labeling [uow_ai_ml_p015_paragraph_001]; 2. Data preparation (preprocessing) [uow_ai_ml_p015_paragraph_001]; 3. Model planning (methods, techniques, workflow, variables, relationships, models) [uow_ai_ml_p015_paragraph_001]; 4. Model building (training and test datasets, software and hardware, analysis of results) [uow_ai_ml_p015_paragraph_001]; 5. Communication of results (identify key findings) [uow_ai_ml_p015_paragraph_001]; 6. Operationalize (delivery, pilot project) [uow_ai_ml_p015_paragraph_001].
